FN-NBIGJJ-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 465
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Rex Reynolds
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 05/12/2023
House Bill 465 as introduced would appropriate a total of $10 million from the Opioid
Treatment and Abatement Fund, for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2023, to the following
entities in the following amounts:
(a) $1.5 million to the Department of Corrections for opioid and co-occurring
substance abuse treatment; and
(b) $8.5 million to the Department of Mental Health to fund a competitive grant
program for community providers that provide opioid treatment, medication, and services.
This bill would also provide that these funds would not revert at the end of fiscal year 2023 but
would carry forward for the purposes appropriated.
